correctness.rationale: Exact center deletion/link identifies X as cofiber of B_(nq,r-1)→join B_(q,min(r,q)). The simplex-skeleton element matching yields exact integral sphere counts; the deletion is contractible or (nr-2)-connected so the inclusion of the (r-2)-dimensional link is null. Augmented exterior chains and the signed join Künneth formula give the integral group modules. Rational invariants vanish by standard symmetric-group hook representation arguments. The standalone checker independently tested graph membership, 3519 actual faces in nine cases, exact mod-two boundaries, 528 signed Lefschetz identities, and 2520 full-group character terms. All boundary cases r=2, r=q and r=nq are included; r≥nq+1 is contractible. No finite test is promoted to an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This gives a complete natural two-parameter and all-higher-threshold integral homotopy classification of clique-bouquet chordal graphs, with a sharp change from two nonzero homology dimensions to one at r=q. The high-rank multiplicities and exact integral wreath-product modules distinguish topological and symmetry information not supplied by enumerating faces or by generic wedge existence. Vanishing rational homology of every full-symmetry quotient is an additional motivated consequence; no unrelated application or paper-size claim is assumed.
